newsitem.title: INDIA: Weizman says PLO talks difficult but offer hope.
newsitem.headline: Weizman says PLO talks difficult but offer hope.

text.p: Israeli President Ezer Weizman said on Monday there were no easy solutions in talks between Israel and Palestinian negotiators over the elusive Hebron deal.

"It's not an easy problem. It's a difficult solution. But I am sure (there would be progress) in the very near future, I don't want to quote dates," Weizman told reporters at the start of his first visit to India.
Weizman said he had spoken to Israeli Defence Minister Yitzhak Mordechai on Monday morning to discuss the issue.
"The defence ministry is doing its best," he said.
Mordechai held a 90-minute meeting with Palestinian President Yasser Arafat in the self-ruled Gaza Strip on Sunday when they discussed the standoff over the West Bank town of Hebron.
"We hope that by tomorrow evening we'll find solutions to the subjects that remain in dispute," Mordechai told reporters on Sunday after his meeting with Arafat.
